hints.content:
To find how many $\maroonD2 \text{ KB}$ pages will fit on the $\maroonD4 \cdot 10^\blue6 \text{ KB}$ drive, we can divide.

$\qquad \dfrac{\maroonD{4} \cdot 10^\blueD6 \text{ KB}}{\maroonD2 \text{ KB}}$

$2 \cdot 10^6$ pages can be stored on the USB drive.   
(That's one long report!)

question.content:
Each page of a top-secret report on aliens requires $2 \text{ KB}$ of space in digital format.  

**What is the maximum number of pages the report can have so that it can be completely stored on a USB drive that holds $4 \cdot 10^6 \text{ KB}$?**  
*Write your answer in scientific notation, and round to one decimal place.*


[[☃ expression 1]] pages
